As part of my PhD studies in the [Kohl Lab](https://www.kohl-lab.com/) at the University of Pittsburgh, I am exploring the impacts of visual environmental enrichment on the behavior and welfare of poison dart frogs and crayfish. This work is not yet complete or published, but was/will be presented at the following conferences:

-   2026 Animal Behavior Society meeting in Cincinnati OH

-   2027 Society for Integrative and Comparative Biology (SICB) meeting in Pittsburgh PA, as part of the symposium "Ecological Attraction: the case for understanding animal aesthetics beyond sexual selection"
